raw_sections.experience:
EXPERIENCE
Business Analyst
Supply Wisdom Services India Pvt Ltd
08/2021 - 09/2025
Bangalore, India
A company specializing in research and analysis for supply chain and risk management
Effective collaboration and participation in Product Management, Research, Teamwork and Collaboration • Managed product development and solution analysis while collaborating with stakeholders to implement digital platforms that enhanced and sustained banking digitization initiatives
Led end-to-end project planning and execution, coordinating cross-functional teams to deliver projects on time and within budget while maintaining high quality standards
Interviewing business units, stakeholders, and technical leaders to gather and clarify business requirements; developing to be business process flows
Verification/Validation of requirements to ensure they deliver business value by conducting various reviews • Served as a Subject Matter Expert, delivering integrated business and technical solutions to develop products aligned with business, operational, and market needs
Provided end-to-end UAT support by coordinating test execution, tracking defects, and validating system behavior against business expectations • Worked under all phases of SDLC methodologies like Waterfall and Agile • Managed tasks and projects using Jira, including creating user stories, tracking bugs, prioritizing backlogs, and ensuring timely completion of sprints in an Agile/Scrum environment
Collaborated with cross-functional teams using Jira workflows and dashboards to monitor progress, improve transparency, and streamline issue resolution and reporting
Hands-on experience with SQL and data warehousing for data analysis, reporting, and process support
Research Analyst (Risk & Compliance)
Supply Wisdom Services India Pvt Ltd
03/2020 - 07/2021
Bangalore, India
Specializes in providing risk management and compliance solutions for businesses
Conducted comprehensive company analysis covering details such as financials, strategy, issues, MGA overview, key management, SWOT, and recent developments
Determined risk ratings using qualitative and quantitative research techniques, and monitored third-party vendor risks in the supply chain through secondary research
Conducted Information Security Risk Assessments for organizations across Banking, IT, and Pharmaceutical sectors • Assisted the US region by providing research reports and analysis on companies, markets, industries, and competitors, including tracking financial releases and comparing financial performance for QoQ and YoY changes
Prepared detailed risk reports with parameters like Financial, Operations, Governance, and Regulatory compliance, provided guidance to mitigate risks, and tracked industry regulations, policies, and areas of interest relevant to clients
Worked in financial services and consulting environments, with strong exposure to Middle/Back Office operations and end-to-end business processes
Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail in complex financial data environments • Familiar with lifecycle management of trades across front, middle, and back office systems
Associate Analyst (Corporate Action)
Attentio Research Center Pvt. Ltd
10/2016 - 03/2020
Hyderabad, India
A firm focused on corporate actions and related advisory services • Active involvement in the field of corporate action • Structuring transactions involving Merger, D-merger, spin off, Split Off, Reverse Merger, Hostile Takeover, Squeeze Out etc • Worked on deals, including sell-side and buy side MGA, LBO, and debt G Equity financing: client presentation • Worked on Event creation and providing the accurate information to the vendors like Bloomberg • Managing and maintaining accurate referential data for corporate actions, ensuring seamless downstream processing • Experienced with SEC filings, i.e., 10K, 10Q, 8K and financial statements • Advisory service in connection with acquisition, business G corporate group restructuring, promoter succession planning
EXPERIENCE
Senior Researcher
GD Research Centre Pvt. Ltd
05/2014 - 10/2016
Hyderabad, India
A research company focusing on data collection and analysis for various industries
Project deals with database creation and collecting information on various industries (includes financial report, contract G agreements) • Handling client queries and evaluating the existing data and bridging the gap between the client's counter data and our data • Managed the company's internal database and worked on publishing reports for interface with the company's clients
